text: Every day I have the same routine. I wake up early, at six o'clock, when my clock rings. First, I get up and take a shower. Then I brush my teeth and dress for school. After that, I eat breakfast with my family. In the morning, I go to school. My classes start at eight. At noon, I eat lunch with my friends. In the afternoon, I study and play games. My father comes home from work in the evening. We eat dinner together at seven o'clock and talk about our day. After dinner, I do my homework. At night, I read a book before I sleep. I never go to bed late because I need eight hours of sleep. My routine helps me feel good every day. On Sunday, my routine is different. I get up late and relax with my family. I like my daily routine because it makes my life easy and happy.
